summary: Caster Freezes themselves, protected from combat and most abilities, until they end it by saying "The earth release me" x2.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: Self-imposed Frozen with no stated duration; lasts until the caster ends it (E2) or it is removed.

termination.note: Caster may end the Frozen State at any time by saying "The earth release me" x2.

properties.note: To end it: "The earth release me" x2.

clarifications.text: The ending phrase may be spoken although the caster is Frozen (Frozen otherwise prevents speaking).

open_questions: E2 lets a Frozen caster speak the release phrase although Frozen prevents speaking; read as a specific exception. The text does not say whether the phrase is an incantation (stopped by Suppressed) or a declaration.
